items.label: Size
items.value: S=US 4-6, M=US 8-10, L=US 12-14, XL=US 16-18, XXL=US 20. Womens summer tops is made of 100%Cotton. The material is comfortable, soft, lightweight, breathable, skin-friendly. Suitable for women, ladies, teen, girls

items.label: Features
items.value: Cap sleeve sweater for women, hollow out, crewneck, bohemian type, loose fit tank tops. Experience the perfect blend of fashion and versatility with our cap sleeve knit tops

items.label: Occasions
items.value: Boho tops for women are great for many occasions such as date, casual weekends, holidays, travel, shopping, photos, party, streetwear, going out, etc. Creating you excellent outfits look in spring and summer

items.label: Match
items.value: This crochet sweater tank tops can easily match shorts, skirts, jeans, pants, sandal for daily casual look, can be worn casually or dressed up, worn separately or layered, perfect for staying cozy and stylish

items.label: Washing Care
items.value: To keep this fashion women's tops in top condition, we recommend hand washing, suggest hang or line dry, do not bleach
